      Difficulty tiers & points

      Set how many points a correct answer is worth for each tier. Hard Lock always uses the hardest tier. Drag the ⠿ handle (or use ▲▼) to rank them: easiest at the top, hardest at the bottom. The order — not the points — decides difficulty for Exodia (which ends on the bottom tier), Hard Lock (bottom tier) and Beginner's Luck (top tier).

      Categories

      Group questions by topic. Points still come from each question's difficulty tier. Give categories the same Group (e.g. "Pokémon") to make a family: players pick the group first, then a category inside it or "Any".

      ✨ Effects

      🏷️ Question preview

      The question appears automatically afterwards (the host can also click "Show now"). Set to 0 to skip the preview.

      ⏱️ Answer timer

      The clock starts when the question appears and stops when you click Reveal answer. Click the clock to pause it. If time runs out, the answer is shown and it counts as wrong.

      🎒 Items

      Players earn an item when they get several answers right in a row (🔥 hot streak) or wrong in a row (🧊 cold streak). Cold-streak items are stronger so players who are behind can catch up. A player can use one item per turn, before picking a question.

      Separate numbers with commas. With 3, 5, 7, a player earns an item on their 3rd, 5th and 7th answer in a row.

      ItemWhat it does🔥 Hot streak🧊 Cold streak

      Untick both boxes to turn an item off completely.

      🔁 Question counter

      The game counts how many times each question has been shown (see the "Seen" column in Edit Questions). Questions seen more often are less likely to come up, so the team sees fewer repeats.

      Backup

      Questions are saved automatically on this computer. Use these to back them up or move them to another computer.
